name: Quan
description: Shu Yun's scribe, who records the khans' meeting.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun dictates a history of Tarkir at Dirgur and prepares to receive the arriving khans at his unprecedented summit.
timeline.quote: This meeting, this council of khans, was Shu Yun's desperate effort to improve the odds of survival.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun takes the Annals scrolls from Quan to hide them and leaps from the window onto Silumgar's dragon, killing it with his tattooed palm.
timeline.quote: His dragon tattoo flashed with magical energy, and he slammed his palm into a very particular spot on the dragon's skull.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun kneels before Ojutai and offers his life to spare the Jeskai; Ojutai freezes him to death.
timeline.quote: The khan of the Jeskai fell.

timeline.summary: Ojutai declares through his aven translator that the Jeskai are no more, orders every ghostfire warrior killed, and commands Quan to erase the names of the clans.
timeline.quote: As of this day, there are no more clans. There are no more khans.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

relations.note: He is Shu Yun's most trusted scribe.
relations.quote: Shu Yun turned to his most trusted scribe, Quan.

pages_say.description: Shu Yun's most trusted scribe, who records the summit and is then ordered by Ojutai to erase the names of the clans from history.
Shu Yun's scribe, who records the khans' meeting.
